messages:
deploy-bot: [ALERT] Canary rollout r-2026-03-17T10:12Z -> 12% on runtime-pool-7. Observed p95 latency jump ~2.2x and throughput drop 30%. Grafana: https://grafana/redwood/d/rp123
oncall-kyra: paging ENG-ONCALL, I'm on it :phone: seeing spikes in eu-west-1, tail latency particularly for long-context requests
mike_sre: confirming, kernel selection moved to 'avx-fallback-v2' on several hosts, eviction + batching backpressure visible in logs
jen_prod: any customer impact? CS queue just flagged 2 high-severity tickets referencing timeouts on search feature
incident-bot: Incident created INC-2026-03-17-72. Severity: P2 -> P1 candidate if not mitigated in 15m. Pager duty escalation routed.
oncall-kyra: rolling manual traffic down to stable group via routing policy, holding canary at 0% for now. Also preparing killflag for new exec path
ops-ryan: logs look like CPU steal + constant small micro-batches causing KV cache churn. Might be batching parameter mis-tuned in the new runtime path
mike_sre: commands to flip temporary killflag:
```
redwoodctl feature-toggle set runtime.execpath.new=false --env=prod --scope=pool:runtime-pool-7
```
I can run if approved
jen_prod: do it. CS impact could escalate if we don't. I'm on handoff to handle comms to affected accounts
oncall-kyra: mike, please apply killflag now and then revert traffic to stable nodes. I'll monitor latency and throughput
mike_sre: applied killflag at 10:35:42Z. deploy-bot: Feature toggle runtime.execpath.new=false applied by mike_sre.
oncall-kyra: traffic rebalanced to stable pools, p95 trending down already from 680ms -> 210ms on batch-critical queries
jen_prod: noted recovery. I'm sending proactive note to two affected customers and CS triage.
mira_eng: adding runbook note: follow-up root-cause hypothesis: new exec path introduced a different batching strategy that interacts poorly with small-sequence workloads, causing thrash and subsequent fallback to safe kernels under load
ops-ryan: collect host-level vmstat, iostat and runtime trace for the canary hosts, saving to s3://redwood-incident/3300012345/ for postmortem
incident-bot: INC-2026-03-17-72 updated: mitigation applied, monitoring for 30m before closing. Postmortem owner: mira_eng.
jen_prod: handoff: on-call kyra -> mike_sre for follow-up, I'll stay on comms for CS until incident closed.
oncall-kyra: thanks all. Opening a small hotfix PR to ensure the fallback path doesn't flip kernel selection aggressively; will coordinate with builds team tomorrow. :white_check_mark:
mike_sre: saving snapshots and traces now. Leaving the temporary killflag in place until patch is validated in canary next deploy.
jen_prod: closing customer loop: CS notified, two affected customers acknowledged mitigation and requested postmortem.
mira_eng: setting postmortem template and timeline. Will include perf-regression test and model of batching behavior.
ops-ryan: adding action item to verify scheduling affinity and batch coalescing metrics in next automated canary run
jen_prod: final note: severity downgraded, keeping incident open for 48h for monitoring and RCA. Great response, team. :tada:
